title: 2-147 Assault Helicopter Battalion supports Northern Minnesota Wildfires Mission
description: The Minnesota National Guard’s St. Paul-based 2-147 Assault Helicopter Battalion is sending two UH-60M Black Hawk helicopters with Bambi water buckets and two Heavy Expanded Mobility Tactical Trucks (HEMTTs) with fueling capability, and the Duluth-based 148th Fighter Wing is sending one fuel truck to Northern Minnesota to provide support to Minnesota Department of Natural Resources wildfire activities by providing aerial fire suppression capabilities. Sixteen soldiers and two airmen will be activated in support of this mission.
keywords: 2-147 Assault Helicopter Battalion, Black Hawk Helicopters, Northern Minnesota Wildfires, Minnesota National Guard
